name: Local ISP FTP Loader
description: Search and STRM importer for private local ISP FTP/HTTP media indexes.
overview: Search local ISP media and add STRM entries to Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Automatically route Movies to Sam Movies, Anime to Sam Anime, and Shows to Sam TV Seris.
Add Media main-menu page for every signed-in user, custom private HTTP/HTTPS/FTP sources, and all compatible Jellyfin libraries.
Poster-card search results and complete Movies, Shows, and Anime directory mapping.
